messages:
Maya (Product): Quick heads-up — aiming to ship release v2.13.0 tomorrow during the 03:00–04:00 UTC change window. Draft release notes and internal announce below, need signoff on wording and pinning. Please +1 if OK or call out blockers.

Maya (Product): Draft internal blurb: 
```
Heads-up: v2.13.0 deploy scheduled for 03:00–04:00 UTC tomorrow. Main changes: model pinning behavior for quantized variants, batching improvements, and a couple of low-risk routing fallbacks. Expected user impact: none. If any issue, rollback to v2.12.9. See runbook.
```

Jorge (Eng): Quick question on pinning — can we pin the quantized model to Dedicated only for this rollout? Want to avoid switching hosted customers until canary completes.

Sam (Eng Release): Yes, plan is: canary on Dedicated -> attendee observed traffic -> promote to Hosted. We'll pin Dedicated pools to v2.13.0-quant, hosted stays on v2.12.9 until canary passes. I'll add routing policy to the deploy job.

Lina (Docs): Small nit on the blurb: add short link to rollback playbook and who to @ in the meantime. Suggest: "If you see regressions, notify @Sam (Eng Release) and @Jorge (Eng) — rollback playbook: <internal link>"

Maya (Product): good call, updating. Also want a tiny FAQ line about perf: "expect ~5-8% latency decrease on high-concurrency workloads" — is that accurate?

Jorge (Eng): 5-8% is fair for batching improvements, but quantization could add +/- variance on tail latency. Add: "may observe tail variance; monitor the latency dashboard"

Sam (Eng Release): I will own the announce pin and the deploybot cues. Rollback criteria: >2x median latency or >3% error rate sustained for 10m. Rollback target: v2.12.9. Oncall: @eng-oncall then @platform-leads.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: staging at 2026-03-25T02:00Z, canary (Dedicated) at 2026-03-25T03:00Z. To cancel: `/deploy cancel 3162023456`

Maya (Product): ok, updated blurb below — final signoff?
```
Internal announce (for engineers):
Heads-up: v2.13.0 deploy scheduled 03:00–04:00 UTC 2026-03-25. Primary changes: Dedicated pinning of v2.13.0-quant, batching optimizations, routing fallback improvements. No expected user-visible changes. If regressions occur (latency >2x median or error rate >3% for 10m), we will rollback to v2.12.9. Contact: @Sam (Eng Release), @Jorge (Eng). Rollback playbook: <internal link>.
```

Lina (Docs): :thumbsup: I can push a one-line changelog to the internal changelog page after deploybot confirms success.

Jorge (Eng): +1 on rollout plan. I'll watch the canary dashboards and run KV cache sanity tests during the canary window.

Sam (Eng Release): All right — I'll post the pin and start the deploy at the scheduled times, and ping this thread when canary is green. If anyone sees anything odd before then, drop it here.

Maya (Product): Thanks team. Final: proceed with scheduled deploy. :party_popper:
